tvs.title_bl1_about: Upper/lower lash line tattoo: expressive eyes without makeup
tvs.text_bl1_about: A lash line tattoo is radically different from a classic eye contour, both in how it is done and in its effect on the eyes. Unlike an eye contour tattoo, lash line enhancement places the pigment exclusively along the lash line. The fine line is barely noticeable, yet it visually adds depth and length to your lashes, so you no longer need daily mascara for a polished look. That is why this upper/lower lash line technique of permanent eye makeup is so popular with women who want to look well-groomed without relying on extra cosmetics. Which eyeliner tattoo suits you best is up to you: you can opt for a classic eyeliner with the line extended onto the eyelid, or for one with soft shading.

tvs.text-bl-seo: Lash line tattooing is a unique technique: no alternative method gives the same effect. The whole secret is that the pigment is placed along the lash line, filling in the gaps between the lashes. As a result, the lash line takes on an even color, and the lashes look noticeably darker and longer. It is an excellent option if you want your lashes to look made up without using mascara. Semi-permanent lash line tattooing is designed not only to give you an attractive look – it can also make every woman's life better. Without a doubt, it means clear savings, both of the time spent on daily makeup and of the money set aside for buying cosmetics.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
What you should know about lash line tattooing

Before booking this procedure, we recommend getting familiar with the key aspects of upper/lower lash line tattooing.

Stages of the lash line enhancement procedure

Lash line tattooing is the only permanent eye makeup technique that requires no pre-drawn outline – there is simply no need for one. The artist works along the entire length of the lash line. The only exception is when you choose to extend the tip of the line above the eyelid.
Before the procedure, the artist applies a numbing cream, then waits 10–20 minutes for the sensitivity to decrease. Then the tattoo is applied. Note that this technique uses an intense black pigment. An additional anesthetic is used during the procedure. It works very quickly, within just a few minutes, and reduces redness and any possible discomfort. At the end of the procedure, the artist will give you skin care advice and recommend the right date for your touch-up.

About the touch-up

A touch-up is not considered mandatory for lash line tattooing. However, it is useful if you need to deepen the color of the line (it may become lighter as the skin heals), cover minor flaws or reshape the line with a different technique – for example, by adding shading or extending its tip.

Before and after the procedure

Right before the procedure, your makeup must be removed without using oil-based products. If you have eyelash extensions, they also need to be removed, so that the glue and artificial lashes don't keep the pigment from reaching every spot next to your natural lashes. If you wear contact lenses, they must be taken out before the procedure, so we recommend bringing a lens case and solution. You can put your lenses back in afterwards.
After the procedure, it is important to let the skin heal on its own. You don't need to apply any ointment or healing cream: thanks to the professional technique, the skin will recover quickly and without problems. The skin usually heals within the first 5–10 days and then continues to recover for another 2–3 weeks. After 28–30 days, the skin can be considered fully healed, and the touch-up can be done. During recovery, avoid steaming your skin, washing your face with hot water and going to the tanning salon, sauna or pool. Intense workouts should also be avoided. Do not scratch or touch your eyes, and don't pick off flaking skin.

Contraindications

Upper/lower lash line tattooing is contraindicated for people with diabetes, pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers, and people with epilepsy or mental health disorders. The tattoo cannot be done if you have conjunctivitis. Menstruation is not a contraindication. If you feel unwell or have a fever or high blood pressure, it is best to reschedule the procedure for another day.

Features of the lash line enhancement technique

Lash line pigmentation truly transforms your face and highlights your eyes, giving them an expressive, natural look. However, it will not hide imperfections around the eyes the way another technique can. An eyeliner tattoo suits absolutely every woman, regardless of age, skin type or eye shape.

Upper and lower lash line tattooing is in high demand among young women and ladies alike. We guarantee that this procedure is an easy way to forget about cosmetics for a long time while looking well-groomed at any moment and in any situation. So if you want to transform your appearance, get a brighter, more captivating gaze and have lashes that look longer and darker, we highly recommend lash line enhancement in the eyeliner technique at an affordable price at our Lbar studio.

migx_questions.questions-title: What is the difference between a lash line tattoo and a classic eyeliner?
migx_questions.questions-text: They differ in technique and in the final look. With a classic eyeliner tattoo, the pigment is placed close to the lash line and above it, depending on the chosen width of the line. With a lash line tattoo, the pigment goes right along the lash line, into the gaps where no lashes grow. The entire line is pigmented, so your eyes look bigger and your lashes longer.

migx_questions.questions-title: Is there any risk of harming the eyes with a semi-permanent lash line tattoo?
migx_questions.questions-text: The procedure is safe. While working, the experienced artist stretches the eyelid, which is then gently turned and held in place. This rules out any risk of the pigment or the needle reaching the mucous membrane of the eye. What's more, even if the client wanted to blink during the procedure, she wouldn't be able to. So you can put all fears and doubts about lash line tattooing aside.

migx_questions.questions-title: Is upper/lower lash line tattooing painful?
migx_questions.questions-text: No. The procedure is painless thanks to an initial and an additional anesthetic. This prevents pain, as well as swelling and pronounced redness of the skin.

migx_questions.questions-title: How long does eyeliner lash line enhancement last?
migx_questions.questions-text: Up to 2 years. It depends on factors such as skin type and lifestyle. In older people and those with dry skin, the effect lasts longer than in younger people and those with oily skin.
